When Temple has the ball (the passing game against the pass defense): Temple’s offense averages 9.3 yards per pass attempt, and Charlotte’s defense allows 9.6 yards per pass attempt (FBS average 7.5).

contradicting: When Temple has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): Temple’s offense has allowed a sack on 8.5% of its dropbacks, and Charlotte’s defense sacks the quarterback on 4.7% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.6%).
